blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consumers may need to brace for power interruptions, as high demand amid tight supply caused by coal plant outages on Tuesday has prompted the grid operator to place the Visayas grid under red alert. In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) said the red alert would be in effect from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. READ: Solon hits DOE for having no quick answer to Visayas power outages A yellow alert would also be in effect from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. and 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. As of 1:40 p.m., the available […]...
